query.title: Customer invoices by billing country
query.purpose: Which of this customer's invoices were billed to a given country?
query.dtql:
from:
  name: Invoice
columns:
  - field: InvoiceId
  - field: BillingCountry
  - field: Total
where:
  and:
    - op: ==
      left:
        field: CustomerId
      right:
        param: Customer.ID
    - op: ==
      left:
        field: BillingCountry
      right:
        param: Country
